arStrings.szText: {c_important}Poison Trap{/c} bursts for an additional {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_A_BURST}{/c} damage when it triggers. Enemies hit by this burst take {c_number}[{SF_39}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage from {c_important}Poison Trap{/c}.

{c_important}Poison Trap's{/c} Cooldown is reduced by {c_number}[SF_44|1|]{/c} seconds. {c_important}Poison Trap{/c} has no arm time, no longer breaks {c_important}{u}Stealth{/u}{/c}, and triggers no Cooldown while you are in {c_important}{u}Stealth{/u}{/c}. All {c_important}Poison Traps{/c} activate when you exit {c_important}{u}Stealth{/u}{/c} and begin {c_important}Poison Trap's{/c} Cooldown.

{c_important}Poison Trap{/c} no longer deals Poisoning damage and instead deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEC_TOOLTIP_DAMAGE}{/c} Frostbite damage and {c_important}{u}Chills{/u}{/c} enemies for {c_number}[{SF_43}|%|]{/c} per second.
{c_important}Poison Trap{/c} Knocks Down enemies for {c_number}{buffduration:KNOCKDOWN}{/c} seconds when it activates.
{c_important}Poison Trap{/c} makes enemies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_48}{/c} seconds when it activates.
You deal {c_number}[{SF_16}*100|%x|]{/c} increased Non-Physical damage to enemies standing inside your {c_important}Poison Trap{/c}.
